items.question: How many refurbished products are there?
Which hazardous materials does the Nordlicht DECT Phone contain?
items.answer:
The query returned four hazardous materials in the Nordlicht DECT phone (P18). Let me summarize the results.

The **Nordlicht DECT phone** contains the following four hazardous materials:

| Component | Hazardous material | CAS no. | Regulation |
|---|---|---|---|
| ABS casing with bromine flame retardant (C18) | **Decabromodipenyl ether** | 1163-19-5 | PBDE under the limit of 0.1% in the FIFRA rule, and the European POPs Regulation (EU) 2019/1021 |
| Printed circuit board with leaded solder (pre-2006) (C15) | **Lead** | 7439-92-1 | Directive 2011/65/EU (FIFRA), up to 0.1% by weight |
| Ni-Cd 2.4V (M10) (C05) | **Cadmium** | 7440-43-9 | Directive 2011/65/EU (FIFRA) at up to 0.01%; European Battery Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 |
| Ni-Cd 2.4V (M10) (C05) | **Nickel** | 7440-02-0 | CLP label: Skin Sens. 1, Carc. 2 |

In other words, this phone contains **Decabromodipenyl ether** (a bromine flame retardant) in the casing, **lead** in a printed circuit board manufactured before 2006, and **cadmium** and **nickel** in the Ni-Cd battery. Please note that the presence of these materials may indicate that the product predates the FIFRA amendment or contains a battery subject to special disposal regulations.
